CORTIS has achieved a major milestone with their 2nd mini album, ‘GREENGREEN’, surpassing 4 million copies in cumulative sales.

According to Circle Chart, ‘GREENGREEN’ recorded approximately 4.1 million copies in cumulative sales during the September 6–12 tracking period. This achievement makes CORTIS one of only two artists in Korea to reach the quadruple million-seller status this year, alongside BTS with ‘ARIRANG’.

The album previously recorded 2,313,291 copies in first-week sales, nearly five times higher than their debut album ‘COLOR OUTSIDE THE LINES’, which recorded 436,467 copies. ‘GREENGREEN’ surpassed 3 million copies just 11 weeks after its release and added another approximately 1 million copies over the following two months.

The popularity of ‘GREENGREEN’ was also driven by the title track ‘REDRED’ and b-side ‘YOUNGCREATORCREW’, as well as various merchandise that increased the appeal and collectibility of the physical album. The extended version, ‘GREENGREEN_playextended’, which includes the new tracks ‘PACK IT UP’ and ‘MONEYMONEYMONEY’, also helped maintain interest in the album.

On the global stage, ‘GREENGREEN’ debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 and has remained on the chart for 18 consecutive weeks. Meanwhile, their debut album ‘COLOR OUTSIDE THE LINES’ has also reached approximately 2.3 million copies in cumulative sales.

This achievement further highlights CORTIS’s rapid growth in just around one year since their debut.
➖️
CORTIS berhasil mencatat pencapaian besar dengan mini album ke-2 mereka, ‘GREENGREEN’, yang telah melampaui 4 juta kopi penjualan kumulatif.

Menurut Circle Chart, ‘GREENGREEN’ mencatat sekitar 4,1 juta kopi berdasarkan periode penjualan 6–12 September. Pencapaian ini menjadikan CORTIS sebagai salah satu dari hanya dua artis yang tahun ini berhasil mencapai status quadruple million seller di Korea, bersama BTS dengan ‘ARIRANG’.

Album tersebut sebelumnya mencatat 2.313.291 kopi pada minggu pertama, meningkat hampir lima kali lipat dibandingkan album debut ‘COLOR OUTSIDE THE LINES’ yang mencatat 436.467 kopi. ‘GREENGREEN’ kemudian menembus 3 juta kopi dalam 11 minggu setelah dirilis dan kembali menambahkan sekitar 1 juta kopi dalam dua bulan berikutnya.

Popularitas ‘GREENGREEN’ turut didorong oleh lagu utama ‘REDRED’ dan lagu b-side ‘YOUNGCREATORCREW’, serta berbagai merchandise yang meningkatkan daya tarik album fisiknya. Extended version ‘GREENGREEN_playextended’, yang menghadirkan lagu baru ‘PACK IT UP’ dan ‘MONEYMONEYMONEY’, juga membantu mempertahankan perhatian terhadap album.

Di pasar global, ‘GREENGREEN’ debut di posisi ke-3 Billboard 200 dan terus bertahan di chart tersebut selama 18 minggu berturut-turut. Sementara itu, album debut ‘COLOR OUTSIDE THE LINES’ juga telah mencapai sekitar 2,3 juta kopi secara kumulatif.

Pencapaian ini semakin memperlihatkan pertumbuhan CORTIS yang pesat sejak debut mereka sekitar satu tahun lalu.

🔔 Ethereum price breakout hinges on a close above $2,535 

➡️ Ethereum price hovered around $2,500 on Sep. 9 as buyers defended short-term support, but weakening momentum and negative capital flows kept a breakout above $2,535 out of reach. Ethereum price traded near $2,486 at the time of writing on Sep. 9 after briefly rising above $2,520 earlier in the session. Price remained almost unchanged on the daily chart as buyers and sellers competed around the psychological $2,500 level.

🔖 The narrow move followed several days of consolidation after ETH recovered from its early-September low near $2,430. Buyers have repeatedly stepped in around $2,478–$2,485, but each attempt to extend the recovery has met selling pressure between $2,525 and $2,535.Spot Ethereum exchange-traded fund outflows have reduced one source of institutional demand during the consolidation. Broader risk appetite has also remained weak ahead of the Federal Reserve’s Sep. 15–16 policy meeting, while higher energy prices linked to the U.S.-Iran conflict have added to inflation concerns.

⚠️ Regulatory uncertainty ahead of the expected U.S. Senate procedural vote on the Clarity Act on Sep. 15 has given institutional investors another reason to limit exposure. Ethereum has consequently struggled to separate from the wider risk-off tone across the crypto market.

🤯 Guy who accidentally paid $3M in BTC gas fees - remember him?

That’s an extreme case, sure, but ChangeNOW support agents see a smaller version of this panic in the chat every single day: "I sent 1 ETH but got less USDC. Where’s the rest?" And while they're always here to help, let's save them (and you) some stress, shall we? 

If your payout is slightly short, it’s usually one of two things:

1️⃣ The "Send Max" trap

If you hit "Send Max", many wallets deduct gas directly from your send amount. You end up sending 0.995 ETH instead of 1 ETH.

2️⃣ Market movement

If you use Floating rate mode and the network is congested, your transaction might pend for some time. Even little time is enough for the price to suddenly drop. Market moves against you → уou get less than the amount you expected.

How to check what happened yourself:

Paste your transaction ID into blockchain explorer like Etherscan or Solscan.

• Sent amount is less than you typed? → Your wallet deducted the gas.
• Full deposit arrived, but payout is lower? → The market moved during confirmation.

Pro tip: Send a test transaction first, check the gas fee before hitting send.

Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense Software IKEv2 Certificate Authentication Denial of Service Vulnerability
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-asaftd-ikev2cert-dos-uWyc2xtv?vs_f=Cisco%20Security%20Advisory%26vs_cat=Security%20Intelligence%26vs_type=RSS%26vs_p=Cisco%20Secure%20Firewall%20Adaptive%20Security%20Appliance%20and%20Secure%20Firewall%20Threat%20Defense%20Software%20IKEv2%20Certificate%20Authentication%20Denial%20of%20Service%20Vulnerability%26vs_k=1

A vulnerability in the certification authentication feature of Internet Key Exchange version 2 (IKEv2) for Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause an affected device to reload unexpectedly.
This vulnerability is due to a logic error during the certificate authentication phase of the IKEv2 connection setup. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by attempting to establish an IKEv2 VPN connection with a crafted certificate. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the IKEv2 process to crash, causing a denial of service (DoS) condition.

Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability.
This advisory is available at the following link:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-asaftd-ikev2cert-dos-uWyc2xtv
This advisory is part of a group of advisories. For a complete list of the advisories and links to them, see Cisco Advance Notification for Publication of September 16, 2026, Security Advisories (https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-notice-jfxK98ZP). In addition, for further documentation of improvements and fixes in Cisco Secure Firewall products, see Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance Software, Secure Firewall Threat Defense Software, and Secure Firewall Management Center Software Hardening Release: September 2026 (https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-hardening-asaftdfmc-uvpPROhN).

It’s called the iPhone Duo. And yes, as many of you may have already heard, it’s the first foldable iPhone in history. The price starts at $1,999.

This is an experiment. Apple is essentially testing whether millions of people are willing to pay for a smartphone like they would for a good laptop. If they are, the price ceiling for premium phones has just been pushed significantly higher for the entire market.

Analysts are already expecting 6–10 million Duo sales in its first year. In a strong scenario, that number could reach 15–20+ million.
